mapper.select: SELECT purchase_id, item_name, category, total_amount, unit_price, quantity, proof_url, remark, created_at FROM purchase_record ORDER BY purchase_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_record(purchase_id, item_name, category, total_amount, unit_price, quantity, proof_url, remark) VALUES(#{purchaseId}, #{itemName}, #{category}, #{totalAmount}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{proofUrl}, #{remark})
